headline: Opposition marches on the Supreme Court over the CEC row, Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia hit a Hyderabad family, and a wave of IPOs opens as Indian markets slide.

stories.title: INDIA bloc protests against CEC, CJI declines meeting
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi accused Modi of protecting CEC Gyanesh Kumar and questioned why people were stopped from reaching the protest site. Kharge asked INDIA bloc MPs to assemble at the Constitution Club. Sources say CJI Surya Kant declined a meeting request because the issues are sub judice.
stories.why_it_matters: A major confrontation over election integrity involving the judiciary and the Opposition.

stories.title: Hyderabad man killed in Riyadh airport attack
stories.summary: A Hyderabad man was killed and his two sons injured in the attack at Riyadh airport. The family was travelling to Madinah after Umrah. His wife and daughter are safe, and his aunt sustained head injuries.
stories.why_it_matters: A direct Telangana link to the Saudi conflict.

stories.title: Two Indian seafarers missing after drone attack on tanker off Oman
stories.summary: Shipping Minister Sonowal said two Indian seafarers are missing and nine were rescued after a drone attack on a tanker at Sohar Anchorage. Local Coast Guard search-and-rescue operations are underway.
stories.why_it_matters: Indian nationals are affected by the escalating Gulf conflict.

stories.title: CJI: protests fine, but keep the Supreme Court out of it
stories.summary: Chief Justice Kant said in open court that democratic and political protests must happen but the court must not be dragged in. He said litigants, lawyers and court staff should not be inconvenienced.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows how the judiciary is responding to the Opposition march.

stories.title: Modi inaugurates Chennai Metro Phase 2 stretch, ₹13,000 cr projects
stories.summary: Modi inaugurated a Chennai Metro Phase 2 stretch, six years after work began, and rode with CM C. Joseph Vijay. He also launched development projects worth ₹13,000 crore.
stories.why_it_matters: Major infrastructure in South India, and a sign of Centre–state dynamics under the new TVK government.

stories.title: Telangana to seek special package from Centre for El Nino
stories.summary: Minister Ponguleti said a delegation meeting PM Modi will seek financial assistance and extra workdays under the VB-G RAM G Scheme.
stories.why_it_matters: Telangana's drought-preparedness push.

stories.title: Telangana farmers urged to skip Rabi crop on water and power shortage
stories.summary: Government advisor Sudarshan Reddy said El Nino could worsen the water and power shortage in coming months, and urged farmers not to take a second crop.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals a serious agrarian stress in Telangana.

stories.title: Supreme Court on preventive detention based on custodial confession
stories.summary: The court held that a confession made before a police officer cannot alone support the subjective satisfaction needed for a preventive detention order. Independent supporting material is required.
stories.why_it_matters: A significant civil-liberties ruling.

stories.title: Hyderabad probe uncovers ₹70 crore mule account network
stories.summary: A cyber fraud probe found accused persons collected bank passbooks, cards, credentials and SIMs from 60 to 70 people. The scam involved a ₹45 lakh offer for an old ₹1 note.
stories.why_it_matters: A fintech-relevant fraud pattern in Hyderabad.

stories.title: Telangana to reconsider Hyderabad Metro-RTC common card charges
stories.summary: The monthly pass costs ₹8,500, of which Metro's share is ₹7,000 and TGSRTC's ₹1,500. The government will revisit the charges.
stories.why_it_matters: Affects Hyderabad commuters.

stories.title: Second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days
stories.summary: One person was killed and 11 injured in the second strike on Riyadh airport. The Saudi capital was hit by multiple attacks from the Iran-backed group over the weekend.
stories.why_it_matters: The Gulf escalation threatens oil, travel and many Indian expatriates.

stories.title: Countries warn citizens against travel to Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: The US, Australia, Canada, Japan, South Korea and New Zealand urged citizens to avoid travel to the kingdom after Houthi attacks. Iran's FM urged diplomacy and offered to facilitate Saudi-Houthi talks.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows how serious the regional escalation is.

stories.title: Backlash over Trump plan to import Russian diesel
stories.summary: Republican and Democratic lawmakers criticised the deal, announced weeks before US midterm elections.
stories.why_it_matters: It affects energy and sanctions politics.

stories.title: Zelensky backs Trump's 'energy ceasefire' if Russia follows
stories.summary: Zelensky said he will support the truce if Moscow does, while saying Russia continues to hit power plants. Separately, Ukraine struck a Yandex data centre for the third time this week.
stories.why_it_matters: A possible de-escalation step in the Ukraine war.

stories.title: North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles
stories.summary: South Korea's Joint Chiefs said one missile launched from the Pyongyang area flew more than 900km.
stories.why_it_matters: Regional security escalation.

stories.title: 139 dead as migrant boat capsizes off Djibouti
stories.summary: The boat was travelling from Djibouti to Yemen with 305 people when it capsized near Obock. At least 139 are dead, including children, and 84 remain missing.
stories.why_it_matters: A major humanitarian tragedy.

stories.title: UK PM Burnham says Russia interfered in 2016 Brexit vote
stories.summary: It is the first time a UK prime minister has publicly acknowledged such interference.
stories.why_it_matters: A notable shift in UK politics.

stories.title: Sensex sinks 1,000 points from day's high; Nifty below 22,400
stories.summary: Ongoing FII selling and rising bond yields hit sentiment, with Tech Mahindra down nearly 4%. Midcap and smallcap indices held up better.
stories.why_it_matters: Context for SIP investors amid a weak market.

stories.title: Global markets: key triggers this week
stories.summary: Markets will track IMF and World Bank meetings, US inflation data, Wall Street bank earnings and China's trade figures. A global bond selloff continues.
stories.why_it_matters: Sets the macro backdrop for Indian markets.

stories.title: TCS rallies 6% in two sessions after Q2 results
stories.summary: TCS reported a 15% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹13,884 crore and declared an interim dividend of ₹12 per share.
stories.why_it_matters: A read on IT-services demand and employers.

stories.title: Nifty 50 fell 7.1% in a year; would diversification have cushioned it?
stories.summary: The piece compares returns across Indian and US equities, gold, real estate and debt over different periods to show how market leadership shifts.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to long-term index-fund investors.

stories.title: Zetwerk sets IPO price band at ₹143–151
stories.summary: B2B manufacturer Zetwerk's IPO is a ₹5,012 crore issue at a price band of ₹143–₹151 per share.
stories.why_it_matters: One of the larger startup IPOs this season.

stories.title: Bonfiglioli Transmissions IPO: ₹2,534 cr, band ₹558–586
stories.summary: The offer-for-sale opens October 15 and closes October 19, with anchors on October 14. Listing is expected by October 23 on BSE and NSE.
stories.why_it_matters: Key dates for an ongoing IPO.

stories.title: Jio Platforms DRHP: Reliance holds 66.43%
stories.summary: Prospectus data shows Reliance holds 66.43%, with Meta, Google, sovereign funds and PE investors holding significant stakes. The listing is mentioned as ₹37.7k crore.
stories.why_it_matters: Details on a very large upcoming listing.

stories.title: Tonbo Imaging sets IPO price band at ₹665–700
stories.summary: The defence tech company's IPO is worth ₹852.1 crore.
stories.why_it_matters: Another IPO in the pipeline.

stories.title: US reverses course on UK testing of AI models
stories.summary: American AI developers can give the British government early access to models for safety testing without running afoul of Trump administration policy.
stories.why_it_matters: It shapes how frontier models get evaluated.

stories.title: Karpathy: gap in shared understanding of LLM capability is widening
stories.summary: Karpathy's post drew 408 points and 570 comments on Hacker News.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful perspective for someone moving into AI engineering.

stories.title: Context Language Models let LLMs manage their own context
stories.summary: Researchers from Meta, MIT and UW introduce CLMs, which edit their own context instead of relying on predefined summarization or retrieval, reporting gains in performance and efficiency.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to agent and context-engineering work.

stories.title: Sequoia-backed Nuvacore raising at ~$2.5B valuation
stories.summary: The CPU startup is raising as demand grows for processors that coordinate Nvidia AI chips and run AI agents.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows where agent infrastructure money is going.

stories.title: AWS adds enhanced custom event buses to EventBridge
stories.summary: A centralized bus can be shared across accounts, with ordered delivery, event replay, content-based deduplication and a new pricing model.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to event-driven backend design.

stories.title: Gremlin's Foresight AI reaches GA
stories.summary: The agentic product analyses services for potential failures, recommends changes and reruns tests to verify fixes.
stories.why_it_matters: An example of agents applied to reliability engineering.

stories.title: TSMC expected to report sixth straight record quarterly profit
stories.summary: Analysts cite strong demand for AI chipmaking capacity and CoWoS packaging.
stories.why_it_matters: A barometer of the AI hardware boom.

stories.title: Ex-Flipkart employees petition to join $2B ESOP buyback
stories.summary: A group of former executives is seeking to bring together 20,000-30,000 former employees of Flipkart and group firms for inclusion in the planned buyback.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to Indian startup compensation.

stories.title: Gajwani: Indian startups pivot to AI and chips
stories.summary: Investors say founders now focus on deep tech such as semiconductors, AI and robotics, backed by patient capital.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals where hiring may grow.

stories.title: Arshdeep and Abhishek power India to 2-1 lead
stories.summary: On a low-bounce Indore pitch, Abhishek Sharma's 30-ball 69 gave India an above-par total.
stories.why_it_matters: India leads the series.

stories.title: Australia in command in South Africa Test
stories.summary: Australia lead by 106 runs after the bowlers hunted as a pack. Steven Smith passed Joe Root for most Test catches by a non-wicketkeeper.
stories.why_it_matters: A notable Test and a record.
